requirement_text: Restaurants shall be able to view orders placed by customers.
user_story: As a restaurant owner, I want to see the orders customers placed, so that I can prepare them.
technical_task: Provide restaurants with a view of the orders placed by customers.
acceptance_criteria: Given a customer has placed an order, when the restaurant opens its orders, then the order is listed.
Given orders from several customers, when the restaurant views them, then each order is shown.

requirement_text: The patient and receiving HCP receive a message (UC30) indicating that the referral was canceled.
user_story: As a patient, I want a message telling me the referral was canceled, so that I know it will not go ahead.
technical_task: Send a cancellation message to the patient and the receiving HCP when a referral is canceled.
acceptance_criteria: Given a referral is canceled, when the cancellation is saved, then the patient receives a message that the referral was canceled.
Given a referral is canceled, when the cancellation is saved, then the receiving HCP receives the same message.
rationale: Role assumed: patient. The receiving HCP is also a recipient.

requirement_text: Status-Based: The connector has been properly engaged and for SAE J1772 S3 is closed or open.
rationale: The sentence lists states and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of connector states?
What must the system do when the connector is engaged and S3 is open or closed?

requirement_text: First field will be add task name.
user_story: As a user, I want the first field of the form to be the task name, so that I start by naming the task.
technical_task: Make the first field of the add-task form the task name.
acceptance_criteria: Given the add task form, when it is displayed, then the first field is the task name.
Given a task name entered in the first field, when the task is saved, then the task carries that name.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation.

requirement_text: User shall be able to search for categories by video name or type.
user_story: As a user, I want to search for categories by video name or type, so that I can find a category quickly.
technical_task: Provide a category search that accepts a video name or a video type.
acceptance_criteria: Given a video name, when the user searches, then the matching categories are shown.
Given a video type, when the user searches, then the matching categories are shown.

requirement_text: The cabin door must remain locked, opening only when a user swipes a valid ATM card in the slot.
user_story: As a resident, I want the cabin door to stay locked and open only when I swipe a valid ATM card, so that only authorized people enter.
technical_task: Keep the cabin door locked and release it only when a valid ATM card is swiped in the slot.
acceptance_criteria: Given no card is swiped, when someone tries to open the cabin door, then it stays locked.
Given a valid ATM card is swiped in the slot, when the user opens the door, then it opens.

requirement_text: The system (Microsoft Excel) shall allow users to enter various data types including numbers, text, dates, and formulas.
user_story: As a spreadsheet user, I want to enter numbers, text, dates and formulas, so that I can record different kinds of data.
technical_task: Accept numbers, text, dates and formulas as cell input in Microsoft Excel.
acceptance_criteria: Given a cell, when the user enters a number, text or a date, then the value is accepted.
Given a cell, when the user enters a formula, then the formula is accepted.

requirement_text: Data Recipient shall use appropriate safeguards to protect the IIHI from misuse or inappropriate disclosure and to prevent any use or disclosure of the IIHI other than as provided in this DUA or as otherwise required by law or regulation.
user_story: As a data owner, I want the Data Recipient to use appropriate safeguards for the IIHI, so that it is not misused or wrongly disclosed.
technical_task: Obligate the Data Recipient to apply safeguards that protect the IIHI against misuse and inappropriate disclosure and prevent any use or disclosure beyond what the DUA or the law allows.
acceptance_criteria: Given the Data Recipient holds the IIHI, when it is handled, then appropriate safeguards protect it from misuse and inappropriate disclosure.
Given a possible use or disclosure of the IIHI, when it is not provided in the DUA or required by law or regulation, then it is prevented.
rationale: Role assumed: data owner. "Appropriate" safeguards are not defined.

requirement_text: Please see the corresponding tecnical reference sheet for details regarding ordering of the information.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the technical reference sheet say about the ordering of the information?
Is the referenced sheet part of this requirement?

requirement_text: Admin shall be able to Manage providers.
user_story: As an admin, I want to manage providers, so that the provider list is correct.
technical_task: Provide admins with functions to manage providers.
acceptance_criteria: Given the provider management area, when the admin adds or edits a provider, then the change is saved.
Given a provider, when the admin removes it, then it is no longer listed.
rationale: Role stated: admin. The management actions are an interpretation.

requirement_text: For all other CAN failures please refer the `` Diagnostic Specification Central Display Telematic5 '' [DSPC-4585] for details.
rationale: The sentence only points to another document.
clarification_questions: What does the Diagnostic Specification Central Display require for all other CAN failures?
Is the referenced document part of this requirement?

requirement_text: If the desired insurance company is not yet entered you can also add it here by completing all the fields and clicking 'Save as New'.
requirement_text_raw: If the desired insurance company is not yet entered  you can also add it here by completing all the fields and clicking 'Save as New'.
user_story: As a user, I want to add an insurance company that is not listed by filling in all fields and clicking Save as New, so that I can record it.
technical_task: Offer a way to add an insurance company that is not yet entered by completing all the fields and choosing 'Save as New'.
acceptance_criteria: Given the insurance company is not yet entered, when the user completes all the fields and clicks 'Save as New', then the company is added.
Given not all fields are completed, when the user clicks 'Save as New', then the company is not added.
rationale: Role assumed: user. The second criterion is an interpretation of "completing all the fields".

requirement_text: System provides error and exception reports.
user_story: As a system administrator, I want error and exception reports from the system, so that I can follow problems.
technical_task: Generate error reports and exception reports.
acceptance_criteria: Given an error occurs, when it is handled, then it appears in an error report.
Given an exception occurs, when it is handled, then it appears in an exception report.

requirement_text: System shall allow users to update their profile details, including name, email, password, mobile number, address, and date of birth, with successful updates confirmed.
user_story: As a user, I want to update my name, email, password, mobile number, address and date of birth and be told the update succeeded, so that my profile is current.
technical_task: Allow updates of the name, email, password, mobile number, address and date of birth in the profile and confirm successful updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given the profile form, when the user changes the name, email, password, mobile number, address or date of birth and saves, then the change is stored.
Given a successful update, when it is saved, then a confirmation is shown.

requirement_text: The sum of the individual-parts prices shall not be larger than the price of the complete battery (see OEM Standard Terms).
user_story: As a customer, I want the individual parts prices to add up to no more than the price of the complete battery, so that buying parts costs no extra.
technical_task: Keep the sum of the individual parts prices at or below the price of the complete battery, in line with the OEM Standard Terms.
acceptance_criteria: Given the prices of the individual parts, when they are added up, then the sum is not larger than the price of the complete battery.
Given a sum that is larger than the complete battery price, when the prices are checked, then the requirement is not met.

requirement_text: A user researcher shall conduct a user definition workshop with NSF.
user_story: As a user researcher, I want to run a user definition workshop with NSF, so that users are defined together.
technical_task: Hold a user definition workshop with NSF led by a user researcher.
acceptance_criteria: Given a user researcher, when the workshop is planned, then it is held with NSF.
Given the workshop, when it is completed, then a user definition has been worked on.

requirement_text: The FTSS software shall provide the identical services in all vehicle modes.
requirement_text_raw: The FTSS software shall [SRS002] provide the identical services in all vehicle modes.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the FTSS software to offer the same services in every vehicle mode, so that behaviour does not depend on mode.
technical_task: Provide the same set of FTSS services in all vehicle modes.
acceptance_criteria: Given any vehicle mode, when the FTSS software runs, then the same services are available.
Given a change of vehicle mode, when the mode changes, then the set of services is unchanged.

requirement_text: The CPCC shall be able to function as a high availability computer for real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control, and remote PLD/FPGA updates.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the CPCC to work as a high availability computer for real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring and control, and remote PLD/FPGA updates, so that those functions keep running.
technical_task: Operate the CPCC as a high availability computer supporting real-time correlator operations, hardware monitoring/control and remote PLD/FPGA updates.
acceptance_criteria: Given real-time correlator operations, when the CPCC runs them, then they are supported.
Given hardware monitoring and control or a remote PLD/FPGA update, when it is requested, then the CPCC performs it.
rationale: Role assumed: systems engineer. The availability level is not given.

requirement_text: The system shall allow admins to view key usage metrics.
user_story: As an admin, I want to view key usage metrics, so that I understand how the system is used.
technical_task: Display key usage metrics to admins.
acceptance_criteria: Given usage data, when an admin opens the metrics view, then key usage metrics are shown.
Given a user who is not an admin, when the user opens the metrics view, then access is refused.
rationale: Role stated: admin. Which metrics are key is not stated.

requirement_text: In case of failure, the system shall undergo reinitialization.
user_story: As a system operator, I want the system to reinitialize after a failure, so that it can recover.
technical_task: Trigger a reinitialization of the system when a failure occurs.
acceptance_criteria: Given a failure occurs, when it is detected, then the system is reinitialized.
Given reinitialization has finished, when the system restarts, then it is operating again.

requirement_text: A Moderator shall be able to specify a warning for total ideas remaining.
user_story: As a moderator, I want to set a warning for the total ideas remaining, so that I know when ideas are running low.
technical_task: Let a moderator specify a warning for the total number of ideas remaining.
acceptance_criteria: Given the remaining ideas, when the moderator specifies a warning, then it is saved.
Given the warning is specified, when the total ideas remaining reach it, then the warning is shown.
rationale: Role stated: moderator. The warning level is chosen by the moderator.

requirement_text: Redundancy Management shall initiate transient NE recovery to restore Byzantine-resilient communications, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
requirement_text_raw: Redundancy Management shall [SRS129] initiate transient NE recovery to restore Byzantine-resilient communications, if alignment is permitted. (Note that NEFU recovery does not depend on whether alignment is permitted.)
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want Redundancy Management to start transient NE recovery when alignment is permitted, so that Byzantine-resilient communications are restored.
technical_task: Initiate transient NE recovery in Redundancy Management to restore Byzantine-resilient communications if alignment is permitted, while NEFU recovery is independent of that permission.
acceptance_criteria: Given alignment is permitted, when a transient NE recovery is needed, then Redundancy Management initiates it.
Given alignment is not permitted, when an NEFU recovery is needed, then it is still performed.

requirement_text: The solution de-identification capability should include: Account numbers.
user_story: As a privacy officer, I want the de-identification capability to include account numbers, so that they are removed from shared data.
technical_task: Include account numbers among the data elements the de-identification capability handles.
acceptance_criteria: Given data that contains account numbers, when it is de-identified, then the account numbers are removed or masked.
Given de-identified data, when it is reviewed, then it contains no account numbers.
rationale: Role assumed: privacy officer. Whether numbers are removed or masked is an interpretation.

requirement_text: The system shall perform basic operations in less than 2 seconds.
user_story: As a user, I want basic operations to finish in less than 2 seconds, so that the system feels fast.
technical_task: Complete basic operations in under 2 seconds.
acceptance_criteria: Given a basic operation, when the user performs it, then it completes in less than 2 seconds.
Given an operation that takes 2 seconds or more, when it is measured, then the requirement is not met.
rationale: Role assumed: user. Which operations are "basic" is not listed.

requirement_text: The solution should identify and document specific user actions that can be performed on the information solution without identification or authentication.
user_story: As a security officer, I want the user actions allowed without identification or authentication identified and documented, so that exposure is known.
technical_task: Identify and document the specific user actions that may be performed on the information solution without identification or authentication.
acceptance_criteria: Given the information solution, when the actions are reviewed, then the user actions possible without identification or authentication are identified.
Given the identified actions, when the documentation is reviewed, then each one is documented.

requirement_text: A Data Publishing User shall be able to update their dataset automatically with source file changes.
user_story: As a Data Publishing User, I want my dataset to update automatically when the source file changes, so that it stays current.
technical_task: Refresh a dataset automatically when its source file changes.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset linked to a source file, when the source file changes, then the dataset is updated automatically.
Given a source file that is unchanged, when the dataset is viewed, then it is not altered.

requirement_text: The diagnostic history window shall display historical diagnostic results for a specific diagnostic.
user_story: As a user, I want the diagnostic history window to show past results of one diagnostic, so that I can see how it changed.
technical_task: Show historical diagnostic results for a selected diagnostic in the diagnostic history window.
acceptance_criteria: Given a specific diagnostic, when the user opens the diagnostic history window, then its historical results are displayed.
Given a different diagnostic, when the user selects it, then the results for that diagnostic are displayed.

requirement_text: The Separation Elapsed Time shall be initialized to zero at startup, and start counting up in the next frame after being notified via an API call that the X-38 vehicle has been released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
requirement_text_raw: The Separation Elapsed Time shall [SRS161] be initialized to zero at startup, and start counting up in the next frame after being notified via an API call that the X-38 vehicle has been released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
user_story: As a flight software engineer, I want the Separation Elapsed Time to start at zero and count up from the frame after the release notice, so that time since release is tracked.
technical_task: Initialize the Separation Elapsed Time to zero at startup and start counting up in the next frame after an API call reports that the X-38 vehicle has been released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System.
acceptance_criteria: Given the system starts up, when it initializes, then the Separation Elapsed Time is zero.
Given an API call notifies that the X-38 vehicle has been released from the Space Shuttle Remote Manipulator System, when the next frame starts, then the Separation Elapsed Time starts counting up.

requirement_text: System shall provide versatility and adaptability to be used in different sectors where file transfer is crucial.
clarification_questions: Which sectors and which file transfer scenarios must be supported?

requirement_text: User shall be able to assign Location information to a Container.
user_story: As a user, I want to assign location information to a container, so that I know where it is.
technical_task: Allow location information to be attached to a container.
acceptance_criteria: Given a container, when the user enters location information and saves, then it is assigned to the container.
Given a container with a location, when it is viewed, then the location is shown.

requirement_text: The HCP's medical identification number should also be maintained.
user_story: As a registrar, I want the HCP's medical identification number kept as well, so that the HCP can be identified.
technical_task: Maintain the medical identification number of the HCP in addition to the other stored data.
acceptance_criteria: Given an HCP record, when it is saved, then the medical identification number is stored.
Given a stored HCP record, when it is viewed, then the medical identification number is shown.

requirement_text: System shall track citation counts for datasets to demonstrate academic impact.
user_story: As a researcher, I want citation counts tracked for datasets, so that I can show their academic impact.
technical_task: Track the number of citations for each dataset.
acceptance_criteria: Given a dataset, when it is cited, then its citation count is updated.
Given a dataset, when it is viewed, then its citation count is shown.

requirement_text: User shall/will be able to ensure acceptable response times even during peak times.
clarification_questions: What response time is acceptable and what load counts as peak time?

requirement_text: The software Code resources analysis shall give a Verification of worst case execution time (WCET).
user_story: As a software developer, I want the code resources analysis to verify worst case execution time, so that timing limits are proven.
technical_task: Have the software code resources analysis provide a verification of the worst case execution time (WCET).
acceptance_criteria: Given the software code resources analysis, when it is carried out, then it yields a verification of the worst case execution time.
Given the verification, when it is reviewed, then it refers to the WCET.

requirement_text: The website shall not be offensive to religious or ethnic groups.
requirement_text_raw: The website shall not be offensive to religious or ethnic groups.'
clarification_questions: Which standard defines "offensive" to religious or ethnic groups?
How is the content to be reviewed?

requirement_text: The KOM-module shall operate as a communication device between a Backend-Server (AppGW) and several ECUs within the vehicle.
user_story: As a vehicle engineer, I want the KOM-module to act as the communication device between the AppGW backend server and the ECUs in the vehicle, so that the backend can reach them.
technical_task: Have the KOM-module relay communication between a backend server (AppGW) and several ECUs in the vehicle.
acceptance_criteria: Given a message from the backend server, when it reaches the KOM-module, then the module passes it to the addressed ECU.
Given a message from an ECU, when it reaches the KOM-module, then the module passes it to the backend server.
rationale: Role assumed: vehicle engineer. The direction handling is an interpretation.

requirement_text: A Data Publishing User shall be able to edit the model of imported data .
user_story: As a Data Publishing User, I want to edit the model of imported data, so that it fits my dataset.
technical_task: Allow editing of the model of imported data.
acceptance_criteria: Given imported data, when the user edits its model and saves, then the change is stored.
Given an edited model, when the data is viewed, then the new model is shown.

requirement_text: The system shall allow searching files by keyword, tag, and across collections.
user_story: As an archivist, I want to search files by keyword and tag and across collections, so that I can find them.
technical_task: Support file search by keyword and by tag, including searches across collections.
acceptance_criteria: Given a keyword, when the user searches, then matching files are listed.
Given a tag or several collections, when the user searches, then matching files from them are listed.

requirement_text: The system shall be able to provide adequate response times for commonly performed functions under both standard and peak loads across all user interfaces of the application.
clarification_questions: What response times are "adequate" for each function, under standard load and peak load?

requirement_text: The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.
requirement_text_raw: The verbiage used within the system shall be consistent with Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community.'
user_story: As a nurse, I want the system's wording to follow Standard English and the national Nursing Community's terms, so that I understand it.
technical_task: Use Standard English and the terminology of the national Nursing Community in system wording.
acceptance_criteria: Given system text, when it is reviewed, then it follows Standard English.
Given system text, when it is reviewed, then its terms match the national Nursing Community terminology.

requirement_text: System shall support delegation of deposition tasks to enable efficient management of research data.
user_story: As a research data manager, I want to delegate deposition tasks, so that data is managed efficiently.
technical_task: Support delegation of deposition tasks to other users.
acceptance_criteria: Given a deposition task, when the user delegates it, then it is assigned to the chosen user.
Given a delegated task, when the assignee opens it, then the task is available to them.

requirement_text: Connector P1 shall have Row z pins 1 through 32 connected to ground, row d pins 1 and 32 connected to +5 VDC, row d pins 2 through 31 connected to ground with the exception of pins 3 through 8, pins 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30 which will not be connected.
requirement_text_raw: Connector P1 shall (3.2.3.1.2.7) have Row z pins 1 through 32 connected to ground, row d pins 1 and 32 connected to +5 VDC, row d pins 2 through 31 connected to ground with the exception of pins 3 through 8, pins 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28, and 30 which will not be connected.
user_story: As a hardware engineer, I want connector P1 pins wired as specified, so that grounds and +5 VDC are connected correctly.
technical_task: Wire connector P1 so that row z pins 1 through 32 are grounded, row d pins 1 and 32 carry +5 VDC, and row d pins 2 through 31 are grounded except pins 3 through 8, 12, 14, 16, 18, 20, 22, 24, 26, 28 and 30, which are not connected.
acceptance_criteria: Given connector P1, when row z is checked, then pins 1 through 32 are connected to ground.
Given connector P1, when row d is checked, then pins 1 and 32 are connected to +5 VDC and the listed pins stay unconnected.

requirement_text: Included is a search feature where you can search for and select from the thousands of billing codes in the database.
requirement_text_raw: Included is a search feature  where you can search for and select from the thousands of billing codes in the database.
user_story: As a billing clerk, I want to search and select from the billing codes in the database, so that I can pick the right code.
technical_task: Provide a search for billing codes in the database from which one can be selected.
acceptance_criteria: Given a search term, when the clerk searches, then matching billing codes are listed.
Given a list of matching billing codes, when the clerk selects one, then it is chosen.

requirement_text: The system shall allow copying and pasting stories from a spreadsheet.
user_story: As a user, I want to copy stories from a spreadsheet and paste them in, so that I avoid retyping.
technical_task: Support copy and paste of stories from a spreadsheet.
acceptance_criteria: Given stories in a spreadsheet, when the user copies and pastes them, then they are added.
Given pasted stories, when they are viewed, then they match the copied content.

requirement_text: The system shall allow users to include visualizations within Data Packages.
user_story: As a data publisher, I want to include visualizations in Data Packages, so that readers can see the data graphically.
technical_task: Allow visualizations to be embedded in Data Packages.
acceptance_criteria: Given a Data Package, when the user adds a visualization, then it is included.
Given a Data Package with a visualization, when it is opened, then the visualization is shown.

requirement_text: User shall be able to add items to their cart by selecting the Add to Cart button.
user_story: As a shopper, I want to put items in my cart with an Add to Cart button, so that I can buy them later.
technical_task: Provide an Add to Cart button that places the selected item in the cart.
acceptance_criteria: Given an item, when the user selects the Add to Cart button, then the item is added to the cart.
Given an item in the cart, when the cart is viewed, then the item is shown.

requirement_text: The timestamp shall be a 32-bit quantity that indicates relative time within the FCC.
requirement_text_raw: The timestamp shall (3.2.2.7.4) be a 32-bit quantity that indicates relative time within the FCC.
user_story: As a systems engineer, I want the timestamp to be a 32-bit quantity showing relative time in the FCC, so that time is stored compactly.
technical_task: Define the timestamp as a 32-bit value representing relative time within the FCC.
acceptance_criteria: Given the timestamp, when its size is checked, then it is 32 bits.
Given the timestamp, when it is read, then it indicates relative time within the FCC.

requirement_text: Remark: For example positioning of all HSD connectors in the same area is helpfully for a closer binding of the wire harness, so that less space is needed.
rationale: The sentence is a remark with an example and states no testable behaviour.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a design remark about connector placement?
What must be positioned in the same area and what space saving is required?

requirement_text: This brings you to the patient's Summary page as well as the Past Encounters & Documents page which lists any previous encounters or files that were uploaded for that patient.
requirement_text_raw: This brings you to the patient's Summary page  as well as the Past Encounters & Documents page which lists any previous encounters or files that were uploaded for that patient.
rationale: The sentence describes what the user sees and states no explicit requirement.
clarification_questions: Is this a requirement or a description of a screen transition?
What must the system do when the user navigates there?

requirement_text: User shall receive form validation for the input of name, email, and password, with a confirmation message if the inputs are valid.
user_story: As a user, I want my name, email and password checked and a confirmation when they are valid, so that I can correct mistakes.
technical_task: Validate the name, email and password inputs and show a confirmation message when they are valid.
acceptance_criteria: Given valid values for name, email and password, when the user submits the form, then a confirmation message is shown.
Given an invalid value for name, email or password, when the user submits the form, then validation feedback is shown.
